title: micro-ROS on STM32H7: agent session opens and closes at once
platform: STM32H743 board running micro-ROS firmware (FreeRTOS, LwIP Ethernet, UDP transport) talking to micro-ROS Agent on a Linux PC
symptom: The micro-ROS agent briefly established a session with the board and then closed it almost immediately; afterwards the board kept sending small packets and never became a working ROS 2 node. In the debugger the reporter saw unexpected data being sent by the board.
provenance: Log copied from the public issue thread (machine output posted by the reporter). Not synthetic. Used in sealed evaluation batch 1, so it is no longer a blind test case.
